# University of North Carolina School of the Arts

> > UNCSA is a conservatory-style public university in Winston-Salem, North Carolina, offering professional training in performing and visual arts with support for alumni entrepreneurship.

The University of North Carolina School of the Arts (UNCSA) is part of the UNC system and features specialized centers including the Center for Design Innovation (CDI) and the Thomas S. Kenan Institute for the Arts. The institution supports alumni through the Artpreneur Initiative and maintains strong connections to the Piedmont Triad region's creative economy.
